cloudEscalation.note: Cloud tier is strictly opt-in. While optIn is false, routing and fallback never select cloud hosts, even when all self-hosted tiers are unreachable. Set optIn to true or export XX_STACK_ALLOW_CLOUD=1 to enable cloud escalation.

rules.name: Prefer the primary lane for implementation and release work
rules.when: implementation, coding, planning, orchestration, review, and release work

rules.name: Prefer the reasoning lane for architecture and deep analysis
rules.when: architecture, investigation, long-context synthesis, and deep reasoning

rules.name: Use overflow for delegated subagents and parallel spillover
rules.when: parallel subagent reasoning, delegated research, overflow analysis, non-blocking long-context slices

rules.name: Use cloud only as explicit opt-in fallback
rules.when: cloud escalation is explicitly opted in AND self-hosted tiers cannot satisfy capability, availability, or reliability requirements

tiers.label: Skippy sglang (Tailscale)
tiers.usageGuidance: Use for implementation, review, planning, orchestration, and release work. sglang batches concurrent requests across the 4x RTX 5090s, so parallel slices are close to free.

hosts.label: Skippy sglang lane (4x RTX 5090)
hosts.connectionNotes: Reached over Tailscale (MagicDNS skippy-debian-5090). Verify with: curl -s http://skippy-debian-5090:30000/v1/models

tiers.label: Skippy sglang long-context lane
tiers.usageGuidance: Same sglang endpoint as the primary lane; use for architecture, synthesis, 262k long-context work, and heavy delegated analysis.

hosts.label: Skippy sglang 262k-context lane
hosts.connectionNotes: Same physical lane as skippy-sglang-5090; listed separately so long-context and deep-reasoning routing preferences stay explicit.

tiers.label: Skippy Ollama fallback (not yet exposed)
tiers.usageGuidance: Disabled until Ollama on the rig is bound to the tailnet. Once enabled, use for delegated work, parallel spillover, and backup reasoning when sglang is down or busy.

hosts.label: Skippy Ollama lane
hosts.connectionNotes: Currently refuses connections: Ollama binds loopback-only by default and has not been exposed on the tailnet. To enable: set OLLAMA_HOST on the rig (see hermes/README.md), verify the model list with `ollama list`, update the model name below, then set enabled to true here and in hermes/config/orchestration.json.

tiers.label: Cloud Fallback (strictly opt-in)
tiers.usageGuidance: Never selected while selectionPolicy.cloudEscalation.optIn is false and XX_STACK_ALLOW_CLOUD is unset. Use only when self-hosted tiers cannot satisfy capability, availability, or reliability constraints.

hosts.label: Cloud API endpoint (template)
hosts.connectionNotes: Template only. Preferred cloud escalation path is the hermes CLI lane documented in hermes/cloud-escalation-policy.md (gpt-5.3-codex, fallback gpt-5.4).
